title.zh: 命名与所指注视的公开数据边界
title.en: Public-data boundary of naming and target gaze

statement.zh: 36名婴儿的1,508次公开命名记录中，三秒窗口有467次记录到其他物体注视而无所指注视；35名婴儿出现此情况。它限制命名自动确保所指注视的测量对应。
statement.en: Among 1,508 public naming records from 36 infants, 467 nominal three-second windows contain other-object gaze with zero target gaze; 35 infants show such cases. This limits automatic naming-to-target-gaze measurement correspondence.

hypotheses.zh: 采用原作者公开分数与窗口，保留全部记录；注视是有限访问代理，不是全部光学可见性、候选表征或学习结果。
hypotheses.en: Use the deposited fractions and windows with every record retained. Gaze is a limited access proxy, not full optical visibility, represented candidates or learning outcomes.

hypotheses.zh: 已知论文结论后作探索性复算；七个窗口是相同经历的重复测量。参与者均值另列，不将各事件当独立样本推断。
hypotheses.en: Exploratory reanalysis with the paper’s conclusion already known. Seven windows repeatedly measure the same events; participant means are separate, without independent-event inference.

hypotheses.zh: 未将目标加其他注视归一化；无已编码物体注视、缩短窗口和小数舍入差异保留。
hypotheses.en: No renormalization to target-plus-other gaze; zero coded-object gaze, shortened windows and decimal rounding differences remain.

correspondence.zh: 所指由观察编码界定；不能将此标签当作学习者已知答案。命名、朝向及物体位置是同一互动中的关系，实际保留与纠正未由这些字段测量。
correspondence.en: The intended target is observer-coded and cannot be assumed as the learner’s known answer. Naming, orientation and object positions are relations within one interaction; these fields do not measure retention or correction.

detail.zh: 检验其合作命名覆盖的经验对应，保留条件证明及覆盖失败反例；没有声称把注视数据形式转换为Lean候选集。
detail.en: Tests the empirical correspondence of cooperative naming coverage while preserving the conditional proof and failure cases; no formal conversion of gaze data into Lean candidate sets is claimed.

detail.zh: 五秒窗口仍有393次其他注视而无所指注视；三秒另45次两者皆零，不能算为已观察到的错误所指。论文与导出数据的分箱／计数对应仍未解决。
detail.en: At five seconds, 393 windows still contain other gaze with zero target gaze. A separate 45 three-second windows have zero on both and cannot be counted as observed wrong reference. Publication/export binning and count correspondence remains unresolved.

does_not_show.zh: 不识别独占算法或社会协调的发育因果。
does_not_show.en: It does not identify a unique algorithm or the developmental causation of coordination.

does_not_show.zh: 不识别意识或演化心理。
does_not_show.en: It does not identify consciousness or evolutionary psychology.

progress.zh: 测得边界的要求：合作命名未被否证；受限的是“每次命名都含所指注视”的测量对应。下一连接具体化为协调线索→经历接纳／加权→保留的指称与纠正。
progress.en: What the boundary requires: cooperative naming is not disproved; the measurement correspondence that every naming includes target gaze is limited. Next: coordination cues → encounter admission/weighting → retained reference and correction.

progress.zh: 后续保留：带后续识别测量的公开数据加入经验约束（encounter-control-and-retention），本项主张、证明与反例不变；下一对应为经验可靠性改变后对新证据的使用。
progress.en: Later retention: a public dataset with a later recognition measure adds an empirical constraint (encounter-control-and-retention), leaving this claim, proof and failures unchanged; next is evidence use after experienced reliability changes.

progress.zh: 来源重释：取得的来源关系以另一路径生成旧命名记录的绑定候选；历史适用范围的反例具体化后续连接。
progress.en: Source reinterpretation: acquired source relations generate binding alternatives for old naming records through an additional route; a historical-applicability counterexample sharpens the next connection.

progress.zh: 历史适用范围：组合与反审把接续问题转向来源—时序保持及持续性假设的经验识别。
progress.en: Historical applicability: its composition and counterreview turn the continuation toward empirical identification of source–time retention and persistence assumptions.

progress.zh: 五篇原典：区分取得、保持与使用；原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。
progress.en: Five primary sources: formation, retention and use are distinguished; primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

validation_scope.zh: 8份原始文件匹配OSF哈希；七窗口的八类计数及参与者统计以独立Decimal算法复算通过。实质作者反审完成；无新实验、独立agent验收或新Lean定理。不是论文全部分析的精确复现。
validation_scope.en: Eight original files match OSF hashes. An independent Decimal calculation verifies eight count categories and participant statistics across seven windows. Substantive author counterreview completed; no new experiment, independent-agent acceptance or new Lean theorem. Not an exact replication of all published analyses.

next_delta.zh: 在保留的既有条件连接之上，于匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。
next_delta.en: Building on the preserved conditional connections, identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：由公开数据直接检验自动注视覆盖，保留未分配时间及发表／导出差异；把下一连接具体化为协调线索、经历接纳／加权与保留纠正。
history.en: 2026-10-08: directly tested automatic gaze coverage with public data, retaining unassigned time and publication/export differences. Specified the next connection through coordination cues, encounter admission/weighting and retained correction.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：已读研究新增19–20节；后续保留测量加入经验约束，未改变本成果声明、证明或既有反例。下一对应具体化为经验可靠性改变后对新证据的使用。
history.en: 2026-10-08: reviewed added study sections 19–20. A later-retention measure adds an empirical constraint without changing this result’s claim, proof or existing failures. The next correspondence is evidence use after experienced reliability changes.
